ask: Add two types to the existing package com.jobcrm.codegen.metrics (directory codegen/src/main/java/com/jobcrm/codegen/metrics) that summarize model-call records. The record CallRecord already exists in that package and must not be changed. Its accessors are: String stage(), String model(), String platformName(), String job() (nullable), long promptTokens(), long completionTokens(), long reasoningTokens(), long timeToFirstTokenMillis(), long totalMillis(), boolean success(), String time() (ISO-8601 text). (1) StageStats: a package-private record holding the summary for ONE stage: the stage name, call count, failure count (calls whose success is false), total prompt tokens, average prompt tokens, total completion tokens, average completion tokens, average total time in milliseconds, maximum total time in milliseconds, and completion tokens per second (total completion tokens divided by the total seconds across the calls; 0 when the total time is 0). It has a static factory that builds one StageStats from a stage name and a non-empty list of CallRecords for that stage. (2) StatsReport: a final class with one static method that takes a List<CallRecord> and returns a plain-text table with one row per stage, sorted by stage name: it groups the records by stage, builds a StageStats for each group, and formats the rows under a header line; an empty list gives the header line only. Do not wire any of this into the CLI or the model client: list that wiring under MANUAL.
